LanguageData.LP_TwilightYear.label: Year of Twilight
LanguageData.LP_TwilightYear.description: The gods' gaze turns upon this land, and the sky is dyed dark red. Divine-infused enemies increase greatly, the leaders of large raids may be possessed by gods, and divine power effects are stronger.
LanguageData.LP_TwilightYear.endMessage: The dark red sky has faded; the Year of Twilight is over.
LanguageData.LP_TwilightYear.letterText: The sky has turned dark red: the Year of Twilight has begun.
